main_text.p: Ch. Thermæ, Eccles.2.8. & fœmin. sed ab alia forma, idem, Esth.2.3.
Ch. Lachrymari, flere, ut Hebr. Jerem.13.17. Thren.2.18.
Ch. Syr. Lachryma. Plural. emph. Lachrymæ. Syre . Idem, Thren.2.11.
Ch. Liquor stillans, proprie: Hinc est Oblatio voluntaria, de rebus liquidis, ut vino, oleo, &c. Primitias tuas, & oblationem voluntariam tuam, Exod.22.29.
Ethpah. Syr. Mirari, admirari, obstupescere. Infinit. Chald. Non est mirandum, Prov.6.30.
Deut.9.19. in Jon. sic legitur in Venet. in oct. Sed legendum Quinque angeli vastatores.
Ch. Ille, iste: Illud, istud. Fœm. Illa, ista, Secundum hoc, Sic, Hujusmodi. In hoc, sc. loco, hic, Jud.18.3. sic Jesa.22.1. Sic, sicut. Ad quid, Quare? Syr. Igitur, Itaque, Ergo, Idcirco.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are printed in their own scripts and are not reproduced here in full; the Hebrew and Syriac characters on this page are largely illegible in the scan. Faint show-through from the reverse page is omitted.
